issues.description: Synchronous readFileSync in hot stack-trace path can hurt performance on large failures
issues.detail: getSourceMap is invoked per frame during parseErrorStacktrace. For each external frame it does existsSync + readFileSync of the entire file, then convert-source-map scans it. With deep stacks or large bundles this is O(frames * filesize) sync I/O on the main reporter path. Consider caching results per file path.

issues.description: resolve(from, '..', s) semantics change may break maps where 'from' is a directory
issues.detail: The fix changes resolve(s, from) to resolve(from, '..', s). This assumes 'from' is always a file path so '..' strips the filename. If 'from' is ever a directory (e.g., for inline maps or virtual modules), '..' will incorrectly drop one path segment, producing wrong resolvedSources. Worth verifying all callers pass file paths.

issues.description: Returning '{}' as fallback source map content may cause convert-source-map to throw or misbehave
issues.detail: createConvertSourceMapReadMap returns '{}' when the referenced map file does not exist. convert-source-map.fromMapFileSource expects a valid source map JSON; '{}' lacks required fields (version, mappings). Depending on the version, this may throw or produce an invalid map rather than the intended graceful fallback. Returning undefined or a minimal valid map would be safer.

issues.description: Mixing 'pathe' and 'node:path' imports in the same file is inconsistent
issues.detail: The file already imports resolve/basename/extname from 'pathe' for cross-platform normalization, but the new code imports 'node:path' and uses path.resolve/path.dirname. This can cause subtle Windows path differences. Prefer using pathe consistently.

issues.description: Importing SourceMap type from 'rollup' adds an unnecessary type coupling
issues.detail: The new code imports SourceMap from 'rollup' purely as a return type annotation for extractSourcemapFromFile. convert-source-map has its own types via @types/convert-source-map which was just added. Using rollup's SourceMap couples this module to a heavier dependency type than needed.

issues.description: moduleGraph.getModuleById uses raw file path; external modules may need normalized/url-ish id
issues.detail: project.vite.moduleGraph.getModuleById typically expects a Vite module id (which can differ from absolute file path, esp. on Windows or with query suffixes). For external modules the lookup may return undefined for files that actually have transformResult, causing the source map override to incorrectly trigger. Worth verifying with a Windows path and querystringed ids.

review.summary: The PR fixes source map resolution for external modules in stack traces by adding a getSourceMap hook that uses convert-source-map. The core fix is reasonable, but introduces sync I/O on a hot path without caching, uses '{}' as a fallback that may not be a valid source map, and mixes 'pathe' with 'node:path'. The resolve() argument reordering in DecodedMap is a semantic change worth verifying for all callers. Overall a targeted fix with some refinement opportunities.
